title: Disney Celebrates America live updates: Fireworks light up New York City skyline
description: ABC is marking America's 250th anniversary with 24 hours of unparalleled programming called "Disney Celebrates America."

title: Weather woes impact July 4th celebrations as National Mall briefly evacuated
description: Americans are celebrating 250 years of independence this Fourth of July, although severe weather is putting a damper on the proceedings in several parts of the country.

title: The Brooklyn Bridge Briefly Catches Fire During a Fireworks Display
description: The fire appeared to have been extinguished by shortly after 10 p.m., the police said. No injuries were reported.

title: At least 19 suspected heat-related deaths in New Jersey as temps soar over the July 4th holiday
description: There have been at least 19 suspected heat-related deaths across New Jersey as temperatures continue to soar over the July 4 holiday, officials said.

title: 5 shot, including 2 kids, while watching fireworks in Brooklyn: sources
description: Five people, including a 7-year-old and a 5-year-old, were shot around 10:35 p.m. this evening while they were watching fireworks in Brooklyn, sources said.
